name: Pairwise_Algebraic_Disguise
description: Replaces the neighborhood sum equation with a pairwise algebraic equation $3(c_u + c_v) - 2 c_u c_v = 5$ that evaluates to true for the domain {1, 2} if and only if the values are different. This forces models to algebraically evaluate the constraint over the domain and recognize the implied bipartite structure, defeating models that rely on surface pattern matching of graph coloring terms or neighborhood sums.
